policy: At most ten paths per cell. Rank positive primary adoption metrics only within a cell. A limited number of primary-unranked paths may qualify through separately recorded numeric evidence: Debian source-package installations (at least 1000, at most three slots per C/C++ non-PLY cell) or GitHub upstream stars (at least 100, filling only slots left empty after primary and Debian paths in PLY and C/C++ cells). Different metrics are never combined into one rank. Zero primary values and missing values do not fill slots without supplemental evidence. A byte-identical lower-adoption PHP PLY family duplicate and a pinned empty Python PDF compatibility distribution are excluded. After adoption ranking, selected paths without a verified container control and parser-derived AFL++ feedback are excluded; a vacated slot is refilled only in primary-rank order by the next-ranked path with its own verified container control and parser-derived AFL++ feedback.

metric_metadata.metric: GitHub stars of primary upstream repository
metric_metadata.limitations: Repository stars proxy project adoption, not WAV parser usage. FFmpeg and raylib serve many formats; dr_wav, miniaudio and raylib share decoder lineage. Counts are compared only within C, never across ecosystems. SoX is unranked because its primary SourceForge project lacks a directly comparable GitHub metric. SDL3_mixer has an SDL-derived WAV decoder and reports metadata from the valid control; seven other paths returned PCM samples. The aubio bottle links Apple AudioToolbox and libsndfile; the actual backend for this control was not isolated. CSFML is a C wrapper over SFML audio, so its stars measure the C package path, not a new WAV engine. SDL2_mixer and SDL3_mixer share the SDL_mixer upstream project count; the former uses sdl2-compat on this host. FreeALUT requires an OpenAL context. SDL2-compat exposes SDL2 WAV loading via SDL3 implementation; its repository stars measure the compatibility package, not a separate engine. SDL2 and SDL3 are releases from one upstream repository and share one star count; this is not release-specific popularity. SDL2_sound and SDL3_sound are separate major-version package APIs from one upstream repository and share its star count and decoder lineage; each adapter identified the built-in Microsoft WAVE decoder. TagLib C bindings wrap its C++ RIFF/WAV parser and report WAV properties only; stars measure the multi-format TagLib repository. GStreamer wavparse is a separately verified plugin in the GStreamer distribution; its primary GitLab project lacks a comparable primary GitHub star count, so it remains unranked. The local FFmpeg Homebrew bottle changed from 9.0.2 to 9.0.2_1 during GStreamer installation and its binary hashes were refreshed; the upstream FFmpeg source release is still 9.0.2.
